teaser.en: A wild relative of the passion fruit, from a genus best treated with caution.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa porini wa pasheni, kutoka jenasi inayofaa kushughulikiwa kwa tahadhari.

summary.en: Mtsotsone is Adenia kirkii, a climber of the passion-flower family. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsotsone ni Adenia kirkii, mtambaa wa familia ya mkarakara. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsotsone is a climber that holds on with coiled tendrils, often from a swollen tuberous base. Like other Adenias it has small greenish flowers and egg-shaped fruits that split open to show seeds in a fleshy covering. Many Adenia species are poisonous.
about.sw: Mtsotsone ni mtambaa unaoshikilia kwa mikono-shikio iliyojikunja, mara nyingi ukitoka kwenye kitako kilichovimba kama kiazi. Kama Adenia nyingine, una maua madogo ya kijani na matunda yenye umbo la yai yanayopasuka kuonyesha mbegu ndani ya ganda lenye nyama. Spishi nyingi za Adenia ni za sumu.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket of East Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani ya Afrika Mashariki.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsotsone but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Adenia kirkii, after Sir John Kirk, the 19th-century Zanzibar consul and botanist.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsotsone lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Adenia kirkii, kwa heshima ya Sir John Kirk, balozi na mtaalamu wa mimea wa Zanzibar wa karne ya 19.

reason.en: Passion fruit, of the same family
Schlechterina, another climber of the passion-flower family
reason.sw: Schlechterina, mtambaa mwingine wa familia ya mkarakara
